_note: Regression tests per defect class, by crate and test function name. The suite reports whether each test EXISTS in the version tree (presence), reads results from a crate-tests run with --crate-logs, or runs them with --run-rust. `crate` is where the test's source lives; `suite`, when present, is the cargo package it RUNS under — horizon-client-lib's lib root is ../horizon-client/src/client_lib.rs, so tests written in crates/horizon-client/src/ run as horizon-client-lib. When a fix lands in a version, its regression test goes here under the class it covers (see docs/DEFECT-SUITE.md). A class with an empty list has no test yet — the suite reports it not-covered. Test names are version-neutral where possible; the 1.21.7-named loot test predates the convention.

menu-sprites.note: horizon-prepare is not in the crate-tests suites, so --crate-logs never covers it; run it with --run-rust or in horizon-prepare's own CI
